transactions_import_hash_key.name: transactions_import_hash_key
transactions_import_hash_key.where: "transactions"."import_hash" is not null and "transactions"."deleted_at" is null

transactions_sign_check.name: transactions_sign_check
transactions_sign_check.value: ("transactions"."type" = 'expense' and "transactions"."amount_cents" < 0) or ("transactions"."type" = 'income' and "transactions"."amount_cents" > 0) or ("transactions"."type" in ('transfer','adjustment') and "transactions"."amount_cents" <> 0)
